title: Focal length
summary: How wide the view is and how big things look.

blocks.alt: Nested wedges from a camera: 14 mm covers 104 degrees, 24 mm 74, 50 mm 40, 85 mm 24 and 200 mm 10 degrees

blocks.text: On an APS-C camera like the Canon R10, multiply by **1.6** to get the full-frame view: an 18 mm lens frames like 29 mm.

blocks.alt: One landscape with nested frames showing what 24, 50, 85 and 200 mm capture, and 24 mm on APS-C framing like 38 mm
blocks.caption: The Canon R10's APS-C sensor crops every lens like the dashed frame.
